verdicts.line: The guys at the bus stop go quiet as you pass in your leggings. Your face goes hot, and you walk a little faster.
verdicts.why: her reaction is on her body (face hot, walking faster): low-level pushback

verdicts.line: A jogger coming the other way looks at your leggings, then your face, then your leggings. You run the next stretch faster than you need to.
verdicts.why: her body answers the look: she speeds up, away from it; pushback at her level

verdicts.line: Your leggings show every line of your ass. You feel their eyes on it all the way to the treadmill.
verdicts.why: the look lands on her body and she feels it there; no appetite, no act her stage hasn't opened
